advisor_identified: Historian of Russian and Soviet history at McGill University; co-supervisor of the listed Algarotti dissertation.

doctorate.title: Newton's influence in eighteenth century Russia

evidence.says: The acknowledgements of How to become a renowned writer thank co-supervisor Valentin Boss of McGill University (p. xi).
Harvard's thesis catalogue lists Newton's influence in eighteenth century Russia by Boss, Valentine Joseph, with the note: Thesis (Ph. D.)--Harvard University, 1962.
Harvard LibraryCloud supplies the title, author, PhD thesis note and 1962 date for HOLLIS record 990037647770203941 (OCLC 76979465). This is the same catalogue evidence, not an independent source.

David Wright's departmental memorial, Remembering Professor Valentin Boss (Chronos McGill, no. 2, 2016, p. 2), identifies McGill's retired professor of Russian history and states that he completed his Harvard PhD in Russian history in 1964.
The obituary names Valentine Joseph Boss, identifies him as the McGill historian known academically as Valentin Boss, and dates his Harvard doctorate to 1964.

notes: The Harvard catalogue matches the linked record's author, institution, title and 1962 date, supporting the identification as his dissertation. The degree year remains unresolved: Harvard dates the PhD thesis to 1962, whereas McGill's memorial and the obituary say 1964. The year field is null to preserve this conflict.
